prompt: Classic FizzBuzz for a single number: return "fizzbuzz" for multiples of both 3 and 5, "fizz" for multiples of 3, "buzz" for multiples of 5, otherwise the number itself as a String.
explanation: An if / else if chain evaluates conditions top to bottom and takes the first match, so the most specific condition -- divisible by both 3 and 5 -- must come first, or 15 would return "fizz" and never reach the combined case. n % 3 == 0 tests divisibility, and String.valueOf(n) converts the int to its text form for the default branch.
hints: Test n % 3 == 0 && n % 5 == 0 first; if "fizz" is checked earlier, 15 never reaches "fizzbuzz".
Use an if / else if / else if / else chain so exactly one branch runs.
String.valueOf(n) (or "" + n) turns the int into a String for the final else.
